content.text: I've seen enough. The page picked "הזול" for me: פסגות account plus the ילין לפידות S&P 500 fund.

input.answer: I'd open a trading account at פסגות ניירות ערך and buy the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund every month. The page says 750 ₪ a month for 15 years (135,000 ₪ put in) comes to about 179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום", meaning in today's money, after fees and tax. It assumes 7% growth a year and 2% inflation a year.

stuck.why: I typed 750 in the box but the slider under it showed 800. I wasn't sure which number it was actually using.
The 'אינפלציה' button sits right next to text about the dollar rate and the European Central Bank. I had to press the button to find the inflation number.

findings.what: I typed 750 for the monthly deposit but the slider shows 800. That made me unsure which amount it used.
I couldn't see the inflation number without pressing a small grey button. Next to it is a line about the dollar and the ECB, which is confusing.
Tax is the biggest cost, 15,364 ₪ out of 18,299 ₪. That's scary, and the small print '84% מהפסד' I didn't get.

findings.what: The two options are only 122 ₪ apart. I wouldn't know why to pick one over the other.
Lots of jargon chips (צוברת, עסקת החלף, מנוטרלת מט״ח). I just skipped them.
